Description: This D-Series lived a long life on a farm in the Southern US. Fitted with the rare 423 V8, the owner has decided to retire the old girl with a bang and enter into the BSports Arena. Beefed up with a reinforced chassis and bumpers, as much weight stripped from it as possible, a powerful Afterburner system, and side pipes, this truck can keep up with the best of em' and still take a beating. It can even handle the occasional corner, thanks to its lowered suspension. The only drawback is the faint smell of manure wafting from the bed.
